instructor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Ali Fahim Ni'ma
subject: 04_Advanced_Software_Eng

questions.question: RAD stands for...
options: Rapid application development
Repeated application development
Relative application development
Ready application development
options_en: Rapid application development
Repeated application development
Relative application development
Ready application development
questions.explanation: RAD is Rapid Application Development, a short-cycle model built on quick iterations.
questions.explanation_ar: RAD هي تطوير التطبيقات السريع، نموذج قصير الدورة قائم على تكرارات سريعة.

questions.question: Which organization is credited with developing RAD in 1980?
questions.question_ar: أي مؤسسة نُسب إليها تطوير RAD عام 1980؟
options: HP developed RAD in 1980
IBM developed RAD in 1980
DEC developed RAD in 1980
Xerox developed RAD in 1980
options_en: HP developed RAD in 1980
IBM developed RAD in 1980
DEC developed RAD in 1980
Xerox developed RAD in 1980
questions.explanation: IBM is credited with developing RAD in 1980. The other companies are not identified as its developer in that account.
questions.explanation_ar: تُنسب نشأة RAD عام 1980 إلى IBM. ولا تُذكر الشركات الأخرى بوصفها الجهة المطوّرة في هذا السياق.

questions.question: Which combination supports RAD's short delivery cycle?
questions.question_ar: أي مزيج يدعم دورة RAD القصيرة؟
options: Unproven technology and delayed user review.
A fixed plan and one final integration.
Modular components, reuse, and parallel teams.
One coupled component and sequential coding.
options_en: Unproven technology and delayed user review.
A fixed plan and one final integration.
Modular components, reuse, and parallel teams.
One coupled component and sequential coding.
options_ar: تقنية غير مستقرة ومراجعة متأخرة للمستخدم.
خطة ثابتة وتكامل نهائي لكل المكونات.
مكونات معيارية وإعادة استخدام وفرق متوازية.
مكوّن مترابط وبرمجة متتابعة لفريق واحد.
questions.explanation: RAD divides a system into independent components developed by teams in parallel and becomes faster when reusable components are available.
questions.explanation_ar: يقسم RAD النظام إلى مكونات مستقلة تطورها فرق بالتوازي، وتزداد سرعته عند توافر مكونات قابلة لإعادة الاستخدام.

questions.question: What team does RAD require?
options: a small team with no user access
a large team of junior developers
an outsourced team working alone
a small skilled development team
options_en: a small team with no user access
a large team of junior developers
an outsourced team working alone
a small skilled development team
options_ar: فريق صغير بلا تواصل مع المستخدم
فريق خارجي يعمل بمعزل عن العميل
questions.explanation: RAD assumes a compact team that can decide and build quickly.
questions.explanation_ar: RAD يفترض فريقاً مدمجاً يقدر على القرار والبناء بسرعة.

questions.question: What delivery window does RAD target?
questions.question_ar: ما نافذة التسليم التي يستهدفها RAD؟
options: sixty to ninety days
six to twelve months
one to two full years
three to five years
options_en: sixty to ninety days
six to twelve months
one to two full years
three to five years
questions.explanation: RAD is aimed at short cycles of roughly 60 to 90 days per deliverable.
questions.explanation_ar: RAD يستهدف دورات قصيرة بنحو 60 إلى 90 يوماً لكل تسليم.

questions.question: What architecture does RAD need?
options: No architecture describing system components
A modular architecture with separate modules
A monolithic architecture in one block
An architecture tied to specialized hardware
options_en: No architecture describing system components
A modular architecture with separate modules
A monolithic architecture in one block
An architecture tied to specialized hardware
options_ar: معمارية غائبة لا تصف مكونات النظام
معمارية معيارية تعتمد على مكونات منفصلة
معمارية متجانسة تجمع النظام في كتلة واحدة
معمارية تعتمد كلياً على عتاد متخصص
questions.explanation: Reusable components let the team assemble the next cycle instead of rebuilding it.
questions.explanation_ar: المكوّنات القابلة للإعادة تتيح تجميع الدورة التالية بدل بنائها من جديد.

questions.question: Which condition is a stated limitation of RAD?
questions.question_ar: أي حالة تُعد قيداً مذكوراً على RAD؟
options: Committed users and rapid development teams.
A system that separates into independent parts.
High technical risk from unproven technology.
Available reusable components and clear modules.
options_en: Committed users and rapid development teams.
A system that separates into independent parts.
High technical risk from unproven technology.
Available reusable components and clear modules.
options_ar: نظام يمكن تقسيمه إلى أجزاء مستقلة.
مخاطر تقنية عالية من تقنية غير مجرّبة.
questions.explanation: RAD may be unsuitable when technical risks are high, such as when a system depends heavily on new technology. Modularity, reuse, and commitment support RAD instead.
questions.explanation_ar: قد لا يناسب RAD المشاريع ذات المخاطر التقنية المرتفعة، مثل الاعتماد الكبير على تقنية جديدة. أما التقسيم وإعادة الاستخدام والالتزام فتدعمه.

questions.question: Which requirement structure best supports RAD?
questions.question_ar: أي بنية للمتطلبات تدعم RAD أكثر؟
options: One tightly coupled module built by one team.
Unrelated features that cannot be separated.
A single design integrated only at the end.
Independent modules developed by parallel teams.
options_en: One tightly coupled module built by one team.
Unrelated features that cannot be separated.
A single design integrated only at the end.
Independent modules developed by parallel teams.
options_ar: تصميم واحد يدمج في نهاية العمل.
questions.explanation: RAD depends on dividing a system into independent components that different teams can develop in parallel. Tight coupling makes that decomposition difficult.
questions.explanation_ar: يعتمد RAD على تقسيم النظام إلى مكونات مستقلة تستطيع فرق مختلفة تطويرها بالتوازي. ويصعّب الترابط الشديد هذا التقسيم.

questions.question: What user condition is essential for RAD's rapid activities?
questions.question_ar: ما شرط المستخدمين الضروري لأنشطة RAD السريعة؟
options: Customers commit to frequent collaboration and reviews.
Customers review the product only after deployment.
Customers avoid prototypes until requirements are fixed.
Customers delegate all development decisions to the team.
options_en: Customers commit to frequent collaboration and reviews.
Customers review the product only after deployment.
Customers avoid prototypes until requirements are fixed.
Customers delegate all development decisions to the team.
options_ar: يراجع العملاء المنتج بعد نشره النهائي.
يتجنب العملاء النماذج حتى تثبيت المتطلبات.
يفوض العملاء قرارات التطوير إلى الفريق.
questions.explanation: RAD can fail when developers and customers are not committed to rapid activities. Frequent collaboration supports the abbreviated development cycle.
questions.explanation_ar: قد يفشل RAD إذا لم يلتزم المطورون والعملاء بالأنشطة السريعة. ويدعم التعاون المتكرر دورة التطوير المختصرة.

questions.question: Which stage follows Process Modeling in the five-stage RAD sequence?
questions.question_ar: أي مرحلة تلي نمذجة العمليات في تسلسل RAD ذي المراحل الخمس؟
options: The Testing and Turnover stage
The Application Generation stage
The Requirements Planning stage
The Detailed Data Modeling stage
options_en: The Testing and Turnover stage
The Application Generation stage
The Requirements Planning stage
The Detailed Data Modeling stage
questions.explanation: Application Generation follows Process Modeling; Testing and Turnover is the final stage.
questions.explanation_ar: تلي مرحلة توليد التطبيقات نمذجة العمليات، أما الاختبار والتسليم فهي المرحلة الأخيرة.
